moon.projection: Equirectangular, 0 degrees longitude at image center; north up. Displayed near side centered at 0 degrees longitude/latitude.
moon.limitations: Photographic WAC mosaic, exposure/white-balance adjusted for human vision; high-latitude gaps filled with LOLA albedo and small dropouts inpainted. Optimized for aesthetics, not scientific analysis. No current-phase, libration or topographic-shadow claim.

night.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Black Marble 2016, Suomi NPP VIIRS. NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Roman, NASA GSFC.
